terms.definitionEn: A reusable declaration parameterized by types supplied or inferred for each use.
terms.definitionAr: تعريف قابل لإعادة الاستخدام وبيستقبل أنواع بتتحدد أو تتستنتج مع كل استخدام.
terms.example: function identity<T>(value: T): T { return value; }

terms.definitionEn: A placeholder name representing a type chosen when a generic declaration is used.
terms.definitionAr: اسم مؤقت بيمثل نوع بيتحدد وقت استخدام التعريف العام.

terms.definitionEn: A concrete type supplied for a generic placeholder, explicitly or through inference.
terms.definitionAr: نوع فعلي بيتبعت مكان الاسم المؤقت، بشكل صريح أو بالاستنتاج.

terms.definitionEn: A function declaration that uses one or more type parameters to preserve relationships between its types.
terms.definitionAr: دالة بتستخدم type parameters عشان تحافظ على العلاقات بين أنواعها.
terms.example: function first<T>(items: T[]): T { return items[0]; }

terms.definitionEn: The compiler's deduction of type arguments from the provided values and expected context.
terms.definitionAr: استنتاج الـ compiler للـ type arguments من القيم والسياق المتوقع.

terms.definitionEn: An interface declaration that accepts type parameters to describe reusable member relationships.
terms.definitionAr: تعريف interface بيقبل type parameters عشان يوصف علاقات أعضاء قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام.

terms.definitionEn: A restriction requiring a type parameter to satisfy a specified shape or relationship.
terms.definitionAr: قيد بيطلب من type parameter إنه يحقق شكل أو علاقة معينة.
terms.example: function size<T extends { length: number }>(x: T) { return x.length; }

terms.definitionEn: A fallback type used when a generic caller does not provide or infer an argument.
terms.definitionAr: نوع بديل بيستخدم لما الاستدعاء العام مايبعتش أو ما يستنتجش argument.

terms.definitionEn: An operator producing a union of the known property key types of an object type.
terms.definitionAr: operator بينتج union بأنواع مفاتيح الخصائص المعروفة في نوع object.
terms.example: type Keys = keyof { id: number; name: string };

terms.definitionEn: Generic syntax that limits a type parameter to values assignable to a required type.
terms.definitionAr: صياغة عامة بتقيد type parameter بالقيم القابلة للإسناد لنوع مطلوب.
terms.example: function getLength<T extends { length: number }>(value: T) { return value.length; }

terms.definitionEn: A type expression that looks up the property value type at a key in another type.
terms.definitionAr: تعبير نوع بيجيب نوع قيمة property عند مفتاح في نوع تاني.

terms.definitionEn: A generic placeholder whose permitted types are restricted by a constraint.
terms.definitionAr: اسم نوع مؤقت الأنواع المسموحة ليه مقيدة بشرط.
terms.example: function merge<T extends object>(left: T, right: T) { return { ...left, ...right }; }

questions.code: function identity<T>(value: T): T { return value; }
questions.question: What relationship does this function preserve?
options: The result has the same type as the supplied value
The result is always converted into a string
The parameter is restricted to object values
The return type is inferred as unknown for every call
questions.explanation: The same type parameter connects the input and result types.
questions.explanationAr: نفس type parameter بيربط نوع المدخل بنوع النتيجة.

questions.code: identity<number>(12);
questions.question: What does the explicit type argument provide?
options: A runtime conversion from text into a numeric value
The type substituted for the function's T parameter
A new parameter named number in the function body
A constraint that allows every possible type
questions.explanation: The explicit argument fills the generic type parameter T with number.
questions.explanationAr: الـ argument الصريح بيحط number مكان type parameter T.

questions.code:
function first<T>(items: T[]): T { return items[0]; }
const name = first(['Ada', 'Lin']);
questions.question: How is T determined for this call?
options: It is always set to unknown for array parameters even when their elements are known
It is inferred as a tuple of exactly two values because two entries were supplied
It is inferred from the array element type as string
It is copied directly from the function's name rather than the argument
questions.explanation: The string array argument allows the compiler to infer string for T.
questions.explanationAr: الـ array النصية بتخلي الـ compiler يستنتج string للنوع T.

questions.code: function pair<T>(left: T, right: T): T[] { return [left, right]; }
questions.question: Which call uses this generic function consistently?
options: pair('id', 4) because T changes for each parameter
pair(true, ['x']) because all values satisfy unknown
pair(3, 'three') because arrays accept mixed types automatically
pair('a', 'b') because both arguments can use the same T
questions.explanation: Both parameters share one T, so compatible arguments can use the same type.
questions.explanationAr: الـ parameters الاتنين بيشاركوا نفس T، فمحتاجين قيم متوافقة.

questions.code:
interface Box<T> { value: T }
const box: Box<number> = { value: 4 };
questions.question: What does number specify in Box<number>?
options: The type used for the interface's value member
A runtime argument passed to a Box constructor
The number of properties required by Box
A key name that must be present in the object
questions.explanation: The type argument makes value a number for this Box instance's type.
questions.explanationAr: الـ type argument بيخلي value من نوع number في النوع ده.

questions.code: function measure<T extends { length: number }>(value: T) { return value.length; }
questions.question: Which argument satisfies the constraint?
options: A number, because all primitives have a length
A string, because it has a numeric length property
A boolean, because it can be converted to an object
A function returning text, because its result has length
questions.explanation: Strings have a numeric length property and satisfy the required shape.
questions.explanationAr: النصوص عندها property اسمها length من نوع number، فبتحقق الشرط.

questions.code: interface Cache<T> { get(key: string): T | undefined }
questions.question: What does T describe in this interface?
options: The string key passed into the get method when looking up an item
The count of methods declared by Cache rather than any stored value
The value type that get may return when present
The runtime class used to construct the cache and allocate its storage
questions.explanation: T represents the cached value type, while undefined represents a missing result.
questions.explanationAr: T بيمثل نوع القيمة المخزنة، وundefined بيمثل عدم وجود نتيجة.

questions.code: function get<T, K extends keyof T>(obj: T, key: K): T[K] { return obj[key]; }
questions.question: What does the K constraint ensure?
options: K is always a numeric array index
The object has every key from every possible type
The returned value is always a string
K must be one of T's known keys
questions.explanation: keyof T forms the allowed property keys, and K is restricted to that set.
questions.explanationAr: keyof T بيحدد مفاتيح الخصائص المسموحة وK بيتقيد بالمجموعة دي.

questions.code: function keep<T extends object>(value: T): T { return value; }
questions.question: What does the constraint rule out?
options: Primitive values such as strings and numbers
Every object with a nested property
All values whose type is inferred from context
Objects that have no declared class
questions.explanation: The object constraint excludes primitive types while allowing object types.
questions.explanationAr: شرط object بيستبعد الأنواع البدائية وبيسمح بأنواع objects.

questions.code:
function identity<T>(value: T): T { return value; }
const result = identity('ready');
questions.question: What runtime value is stored in result?
options: 'ready'
'string'
undefined
questions.explanation: Generics are erased, and the function returns the supplied string value.
questions.explanationAr: الـ generics بتتشال، والدالة بترجع النص اللي اتبعتلها.

questions.code:
type Person = { name: string; age: number };
type Age = Person['age'];
questions.question: Which type does Age resolve to?
options: string
number
keyof Person
Person
questions.explanation: Indexed access at the age key gives that property's declared type.
questions.explanationAr: الوصول النوعي عند مفتاح age بيرجع النوع المعلن للخاصية.

questions.code: function measure<T extends { length: number }>(value: T): number { return value.length; }
questions.question: What is the declared return type of measure?
questions.explanation: The function explicitly declares number as its result type.
questions.explanationAr: الدالة معلنة صراحة إن نوع نتيجتها number.

questions.prompt: Declare the generic type placeholder for this function.
questions.code: function identity<____>(value: T): T { return value; }
questions.explanation: The type parameter is introduced between angle brackets.
questions.explanationAr: الـ type parameter بيتعرف بين علامتي الزاوية.

questions.prompt: Return an array whose element type matches the input type.
questions.code: function list<T>(value: T): ____ { return [value]; }
questions.explanation: T[] denotes an array whose elements have the generic type T.
questions.explanationAr: T[] معناها قائمة عناصرها من النوع العام T.

questions.prompt: Apply number as the value type for this box.
questions.code: const box: Box<____> = { value: 8 };
questions.explanation: A type argument selects the concrete value type for Box.
questions.explanationAr: الـ type argument بيحدد نوع القيمة الفعلي لـ Box.

questions.prompt: Require the generic value to have a numeric length property.
questions.code: function size<T ____ { length: number }>(value: T) { return value.length; }
questions.explanation: extends introduces a structural constraint on the type parameter.
questions.explanationAr: extends بتبدأ قيد شكلي على type parameter.

questions.prompt: Restrict K to keys declared on T.
questions.code: function read<T, K extends ____ T>(obj: T, key: K) { return obj[key]; }
questions.explanation: keyof T produces the property key types for T.
questions.explanationAr: keyof T بينتج أنواع مفاتيح الخصائص الموجودة في T.

questions.prompt: Give this generic interface a string type when none is specified.
questions.code: interface Item<T = ____> { value: T }
questions.explanation: The default type argument is used when a caller omits T.
questions.explanationAr: النوع الافتراضي بيتستخدم لما اللي بيستدعي يسيب T.

questions.prompt: Look up the property type for key K on T.
questions.code: type Value<T, K extends keyof T> = T[____];
questions.explanation: Indexed access uses the key type inside square brackets.
questions.explanationAr: الوصول النوعي بيستخدم نوع المفتاح بين أقواس مربعة.

questions.prompt: Restrict this type parameter to object values.
questions.code: function clone<T ____ object>(value: T): T { return value; }
questions.explanation: The extends constraint limits T to types compatible with object.
questions.explanationAr: قيد extends بيحصر T في الأنواع المتوافقة مع object.

questions.question: What problem do generics solve compared with using any?
keyPoints: They preserve relationships between input and output types
They allow reuse across compatible types
They keep checking instead of opting out
questions.modelAnswer: Generics let one implementation work with multiple types while preserving relationships between them. For example, an identity function can return the same type it receives, so callers retain useful information. Using any would allow reuse but discard that relationship and much of the checking.
questions.explanation: Generics provide reusable code without abandoning type relationships.
questions.explanationAr: الـ generics بتوفر إعادة استخدام من غير ما تفقد علاقة الأنواع.

questions.question: Why would a generic function use a constraint?
keyPoints: It limits which types can be supplied
It exposes known members to the function body
It preserves the concrete type parameter
questions.modelAnswer: A constraint limits the accepted type arguments to values with a required shape or relationship. It lets the implementation safely use the constrained members while retaining the caller's more specific type. A constraint does not replace the type parameter with the constraint itself.
questions.explanation: Constraints enable safe operations while retaining the actual generic type.
questions.explanationAr: القيود بتسمح بعمليات آمنة مع الحفاظ على النوع العام الفعلي.

questions.question: How do keyof and indexed access types work together?
keyPoints: A key parameter can be restricted to that set
T[K] obtains the associated property value type
questions.modelAnswer: keyof T creates a union of the keys known on T. A generic key parameter constrained to that union accepts only valid keys. The indexed access type T[K] then gives the property value type corresponding to the selected key.
questions.explanation: Together, these operators connect a valid property key to its value type.
questions.explanationAr: مع بعض بيربطوا مفتاح property صحيح بنوع القيمة بتاعته.

questions.question: When is a default type parameter useful?
keyPoints: It gives a common type when callers omit an argument
Callers can still supply a different compatible type
Defaults can simplify common generic uses
questions.modelAnswer: A default type parameter supplies a common type when a caller does not provide one. Callers may still specify another type argument when they need a different shape. Defaults can make everyday uses shorter without removing generic flexibility.
questions.explanation: Defaults reduce repetition while preserving explicit specialization.
questions.explanationAr: الافتراضي بيقلل التكرار مع الحفاظ على إمكانية تحديد نوع مختلف.
